skill.name: kleros-ipfs-upload
skill.description: Upload Kleros dispute evidence and related artifacts to IPFS through an x402 gateway. The bundled scripts pay $0.01 USDC on Base per successful upload.
skill.summary: Pay for and upload Kleros artifacts to IPFS, then return their CIDs and gateway URLs.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, TypeScript template literals, URLs, and documentation examples. Confirmed risks include wallet-secret handling, external uploads, configurable payment endpoints, and real USDC authorization without a local spending cap. No prompt injection or overt credential-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: The scripts trust live x402 payment terms without enforcing the documented fee.
remediation.suggestion: Validate the network, token contract, payee, and maximum amount before signing. Require explicit user confirmation for every paid request.

remediation.issue: Raw wallet keys and CDP secrets can appear in environment variables, command history, files, or logs.
remediation.suggestion: Use a secret manager and a dedicated low-balance wallet. Remove inline credential examples and redact sensitive diagnostics.

remediation.issue: GATEWAY_URL can redirect uploads and payment signing to any origin.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist the Kleros HTTPS origin by default. Require a separate explicit override and confirmation for any other host.

remediation.issue: The runners can read and upload any file path accessible to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Canonicalize the path, restrict it to approved workspace roots, and confirm the exact file before sending bytes externally.

remediation.issue: Dependency installation is nondeterministic because no lockfile is committed.
remediation.suggestion: Commit a reviewed lockfile, pin exact versions, and use npm ci with integrity verification.

content.user_title: Upload Kleros Evidence to IPFS with x402
content.value_statement: Kleros evidence needs durable IPFS references, but x402 payment and CID handling add setup work. This skill uploads files, pays the gateway, and returns usable links.
actual_capabilities: Uploads one local file to the Kleros IPFS gateway through a paid x402 request.
Supports raw EVM private keys or Coinbase CDP server account credentials.
Tags uploads with operation values such as evidence, meta-evidence, or justification.
Prints returned IPFS CIDs and ready-to-use Kleros gateway URLs.
Checks the CDP payer address and Base USDC balance before CDP uploads.
Provides free health, discovery, and unpaid payment-challenge checks.
limitations: Each successful upload spends real USDC on Base mainnet.
The bundled scripts accept one local file and do not enforce Kleros-only content.
The gateway limits the total multipart request body to 4 MiB.
Operation requires network access, npm dependencies, and wallet credentials.

use_cases.title: Attach dispute evidence
use_cases.description: Upload a screenshot or document and receive a CID for a Kleros dispute.

use_cases.title: Publish meta-evidence
use_cases.description: Pin court rules or policy JSON before referencing the content from a contract.

use_cases.title: Validate gateway operations
use_cases.description: Run free checks and one paid smoke test before relying on the upload path.

prompt_templates.title: Upload one evidence file
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [file path] as Kleros dispute evidence. Confirm the cost before payment, then return the CID and gateway URL.

prompt_templates.title: Publish meta-evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [JSON file] with the meta-evidence operation. Verify the size first, then return the CID for contract use.

prompt_templates.title: Use Coinbase CDP
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [file path] through the configured CDP account. Show the payer address, USDC balance, payment terms, CID, and URL.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and run a smoke test
prompt_templates.prompt: Run all free gateway checks, verify the live payee and fee, request approval, perform one paid test, and confirm retrieval.

output_examples.output: Upload completed. CID: /ipfs/QmExample. Kleros gateway URL: https://cdn.kleros.link/ipfs/QmExample.

output_examples.input: Run the free checks for the Kleros x402 gateway.
output: Discovery reported Base mainnet and the current USDC payment terms.
The unpaid upload returned the expected 402 challenge.

best_practices: Run free pre-flight checks and verify live payment terms before any paid upload.
Use a dedicated wallet with limited Base USDC and keep credentials out of logs and shell history.
Confirm the file path, content sensitivity, operation tag, and size before upload.
anti_patterns: Do not use this gateway for unrelated generic IPFS storage.
Do not upload secrets, private evidence, or unintended local files without explicit approval.
Do not repeat paid tests after one successful end-to-end verification.

faq.question: How much does an upload cost?
faq.answer: The skill documents a $0.01 USDC fee per successful upload. Verify live terms before signing because gateway terms can change.

faq.question: Which network does payment use?
faq.answer: Payments use USDC on Base mainnet. The payer wallet must hold enough Base USDC.

faq.question: Which credentials are supported?
faq.answer: Use a raw EVM private key or Coinbase CDP API, wallet, and account credentials.

faq.question: What is the upload size limit?
faq.answer: The total multipart body must remain below 4 MiB, including framing overhead.

faq.question: What does the skill return?
faq.answer: It prints IPFS CIDs and any ready-to-use Kleros gateway URLs returned by the service.

faq.question: Should I use this for generic IPFS storage?
faq.answer: No. Use a general pinning provider when the content has no Kleros purpose.
